title: Powers of Inspectors
summary: Empowers DGMS inspectors to enter, inspect and examine any mine, its machinery and records, and to require the owner/manager to produce documents or answer questions relevant to compliance. This is the statutory basis for the app's 'Section 22' inspection notices.

title: Facilities to be afforded to Inspectors
summary: Requires the mine owner, agent and manager to provide inspectors with reasonable facilities to carry out an inspection, including access, assistance and information.

title: Notice of Accidents
summary: Obliges the manager to report specified categories of accidents (death, serious bodily injury, and other notifiable events) to the Chief Inspector/DGMS within the prescribed time and form.

title: Duties of Safety Officer
summary: Sets out the safety officer's responsibilities for hazard identification, safety audits and reporting at the colliery, forming the basis of the app's safety-officer hazard-dossier workflow.

title: Safety Committee and Reporting
summary: Requires periodic safety-committee review of incidents and corrective actions, and structured reporting of the same up the management chain.

title: Maintenance of Machinery and Plant
summary: Covers periodic examination, testing and certified maintenance of heavy earth-moving machinery (HEMM) and other mechanical plant, including record-keeping of inspections and repairs.

title: Power of Central Government to take measures
summary: Grants the Central Government power to take measures to protect and improve environmental quality, including laying down standards for emissions and discharges.

title: Persons carrying on industry not to allow emission beyond standards
summary: Prohibits any person operating an industry, operation or process from discharging or emitting pollutants in excess of the prescribed standards — the basis for the app's air/water/noise threshold checks.

title: Penalty for contravention
summary: Prescribes penalties, including imprisonment and fines, for failure to comply with the Act's provisions or directions issued under it.

title: Liability of principal employer in certain cases
summary: Makes the principal employer liable for welfare and health amenities to contract labour if the contractor fails to provide them, and allows the cost to be recovered from the contractor.

title: Responsibility for payment of wages
summary: Places primary responsibility for timely wage payment to contract labour on the contractor, with the principal employer liable to pay (and recover) if the contractor defaults.

title: Registers and Records
summary: Requires principal employers and contractors to maintain registers of contract labour, hours of work, wages and other prescribed particulars, available for inspection.
